thread:
sara: Thinking we should enable spec-decoding v2 for a canary on redwood-medium-v1. Proposal: 20% traffic, 24h observation window. Looking for quick sign-offs and any guardrail suggestions.

jia: +1 on a 20% canary but we need targeted evals too. Can we auto-run these prompt sets during the canary: `qa/regression/core`, `safety/violations/light`?

sara: Yeah planning to trigger the eval job every 2h for the window. Will post the eval subset and expected deltas. main concern is regressions on long-turn conversations.

morgan: product note — prioritize hallucination and fact-check rates over raw latency. If hallucination delta > 0.3% we should pause. Also watch any drop in completion quality score.

devon: infra check: 20% may increase p99 CPU on some older nodes due to different kernel path. I'll reserve 4 extra worker slots in us-west-2 for the canary window. @tim can you add a fallback route if capacity spikes?

tim: I can add a routing fallback to the compatible quantized variant. Proposed flag and route rule: `specdec.v2.enabled` + audience by cohort_id. Example route rule in JSON for ops:
```json
{
  "route": "/v1/generate",
  "model": "redwood-medium-v1",
  "overrides": {"specdec.v2.enabled": true},
  "audience": {"percent": 20, "scope": "cohort:specdec-canary-2026-03"}
}
```
Use cohort-based bucketing so we can exclude enterprise accounts.

jia: Also add a kv-cache bypass toggle for the canary? We saw interactions where speculative decoding + certain kv-ttl leads to stale prefix issues. Maybe `kv.cache.prefetch=false` for the cohort until we confirm.

sara: Good catch. Plan: canary cohort will have `specdec.v2.enabled=true` and `kv.cache.prefetch=false`. We'll run the evals and live metrics: p95 latency, p99 latency, token cost, hallucination rate, throughput/s.

morgan: Which dashboards/alerts to use? Add a regression alert on hallucination and a cost increase alert on token/unit > +8% compared to baseline.

devon: I'll wire up an alert:
- `alert/specdec-hallucination` -> fires if hallucination_delta >= 0.003 over 30m
- `alert/specdec-cost` -> fires if token_cost_pct_change >= 8% over 1h
I'll also add a runbook link.

sara: PR is up: https://git.internal/redwood/eng-runtime/pulls/4782 (specdec toggle + cohort config). @tim please review routing change, @devon can you confirm reserved slots are visible?

tim: Reviewing now. Quick comments on the PR about fallback model mapping and a minor path check. I'll push a follow-up commit.

devon: Reserved slots created: worker-pool-canary-2026-03 (4 nodes). I added capacity-based autoscale margin +20% for the cohort.

jia: On eval side I kicked off a dry run against a snapshot:
```
./ci/run-evals --suite qa/regression/core --cohort specdec-canary-2026-03 --dry-run
```
Dry run looked stable but flagged a few long-conversation regressions (3 examples). I'll paste minimal repro in the PR comments.

sara: Putting rollout checklist here:
1) Merge PR
2) Create cohort in bucketing service `specdec-canary-2026-03` (20%)
3) Schedule canary start 2026-03-20 06:00 UTC (24h)
4) Ops reserves nodes (done)
5) Monitor eval + alerts, hold if hallucination alert fires or p99 > baseline + 30ms
6) If no regressions after 24h, expand to 50% then GA after another 48h

morgan: :thumbsup: Agreed. Also flag legal/enterprise exclude list — do not include enterprise customers.

tim: FYI I've added a quick safeguard to route config to force fallback to quantized model if p99 latency exceeds 2x baseline for 5m. That should keep SLAs intact.

sara: Code-review ping to @tim and @jia for final sign-off. If both ok I'll merge and schedule the canary start.

deploy-bot: Reminder — merge window opens 2026-03-20 05:30 UTC. Auto-deploy will run if PR has 2 approvals and no blocking alerts.

tim: Approved after minor fix (pushed).

jia: Approved — left repro cases in PR.

sara: Merged. Scheduling canary for 2026-03-20 06:00 UTC. Thanks everyone.

devon: I'll keep on-call watch for the window. Ping me if alerts fire.

morgan: Will monitor product metrics and reach out if any user-facing regressions show up.

sara: Closing coordination thread — will post the 24h report in #eng-runtime after the window. :white_check_mark:
